caseName: Retirement Fund Trust of the Plumbing, Heating & Piping Industry v. Johns
caseNameFull: Retirement Fund Trust of the Plumbing, Heating & Piping Industry of Southern California v. Johns

opinions.text: Appeal from Ct. App. Cal., 4th App. Dist., dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, cer-tiorari denied.
